entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for calling VeloFit, my name is David. How can I help you today?
Yeah, I need to return something. Order number is 774-B-91. Can I do it, yes or no?

I can certainly look into that for you. One moment while I pull up that order... Okay, I see the order for the Pro-Series cycling shoes, delivered five days ago. To make sure I'm documenting this correctly, could you tell me what the issue was?
They don't fit right. The spot for the cleats feels wrong and they gave me blisters after a single ride. I just want a refund.
I'm sorry to hear they weren't comfortable. That's no problem at all. Since the item was delivered just five days ago, you're well within the 90-day return window for a full refund.

Yes, absolutely. I have just initiated the return for you. I've sent a prepaid shipping label to the email on file. Just pack the cycling shoes in the original box, attach the label, and you can drop it off at any designated shipping partner. Your refund will be processed as soon as we receive the item.
You're very welcome. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a great day.
